cohort: The cohort comprised 263,904 children born to HBV-infected mothers and 791,712 matched controls born to uninfected mothers, identified from live births in the Korean National Health Insurance Service database from 2005 to 2019.
finding: Children born to HBV-infected mothers, especially those directly infected with HBV, showed a modestly increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders.
followup_time: up to 14 years (from birth in 2005 to observation in 2019)
